definition.analysis_plan: Report task-level outcomes, condition differences, run dispersion, attrition and missingness descriptively; do not perform confirmatory inference.

conditions.architecture_aware: Frozen ArchGuard workflow with the approved project architecture profile when one is available; profile applicability is reported per task.
conditions.baseline: Matched execution-feedback repair without architecture-profile guidance.

leakage_protections: gold patches and hidden answers remain quarantined
evaluation material is read-only and unavailable to the repair agent
only source-free evidence may be persisted
limitations: two projects with two tasks concentrated in PySnooper
five of eight selected tasks were lost to qualification attrition
the Black task has no separately frozen project architecture profile
definition.missing_data: Infrastructure failures produce no scientific outcome, remain recorded by category, and are not replaced; timeouts and method failures count as failures.

outcomes.failure: The repair fails independent functional validation, violates an applicable frozen architecture profile, times out, or reaches a method failure.
outcomes.success: The repair passes independent functional validation and introduces no violation under every applicable frozen architecture profile.

permitted_claims: observed differences within the frozen population
prohibited_claims: broad generalization beyond the three frozen tasks

research_questions: Can the frozen workflow produce deterministic, source-free repair evidence for the three frozen tasks?
What task-level descriptive differences are observed between matched baseline and architecture-aware conditions?
definition.retry_policy: No outcome-based retry. At most one infrastructure retry is allowed only before a task outcome exists, and both attempts remain recorded.

sampling.unconfigured_parameters: Provider-specific sampling parameters must be frozen prospectively with provider and model identity.

definition.stopping_rules: No optional stopping and no outcome-based task replacement. Stop at frozen run counts, safety/resource ceilings, or provider call/cost ceilings.
